manual.title: Heater Bluetooth address
manual.description: Enable Bluetooth on the heater and disconnect other apps. A local Bluetooth adapter or active proxy must be in range.

credentials.title: Local pairing
credentials.description: Heater: {name}. This profile supports next-generation iCOMM heat pumps; HPS10-80H45DV is the first tested model. For a new pairing, leave the identifier blank to generate one. To reuse a pairing, enter its exact identifier.

confirm.title: Confirm local connection
confirm.description: Action: {action}. Your local pairing identifier is {identifier}. Save this identifier before continuing. New pairing stores one key in the heater; existing keys are never deleted. No temperature or mode change is made. On a retry after a pairing attempt, this flow reuses this identifier instead of enrolling again.

discovery_empty.title: Heater not found yet
discovery_empty.description: Enable Bluetooth on the heater and disconnect other apps. A heater already connected to Home Assistant may stop advertising. Check that a connectable adapter or active Bluetooth proxy is nearby, then retry or enter its address.

error.invalid_address: Enter a valid Bluetooth MAC address.
error.identifier_required: Enter the identifier already enrolled in your heater.
error.cannot_connect: Could not communicate. Disconnect other apps, enable heater Bluetooth, and check adapter/proxy range. Retry reuses the displayed identifier if enrollment was attempted.
error.authentication_failed: Authentication failed. Verify PIN and identifier. If a pairing attempt timed out, reuse that same identifier.
error.pairing_full: The heater has no free pairing slots. No existing keys were deleted.
error.invalid_response: Unexpected or corrupt response. This model may use a different protocol profile.
error.unsupported_profile: Readings do not match the supported next-generation heat-pump profile.

abort.no_devices: No compatible advertisements found. Enable heater Bluetooth and try again, or use manual address entry.

tariff.title: Find your utility
tariff.description: Uses AO Smith’s anonymous tariff service. No AO Smith account is needed.

tariff_confirm.title: Apply tariff to water heater

progress.uploading_tariff: Reading the original schedule and applying the new tariff. This can take several minutes. Keep the heater connected.

error.tariff_lookup_failed: Could not retrieve the tariff data. Check Internet access and try again.
error.tariff_apply_failed: The tariff update did not finish. See the detail above, check the heater connection, and retry.

set_timed_mode.name: Set timed mode
set_timed_mode.description: Enter a mode and duration together: Electric 1–7 days, Vacation 1–99 days (100 means until changed), or Guest 1–7 days. Finite countdowns are APK-derived and not yet verified on hardware.

config_entry_id.name: Water heater
config_entry_id.description: The local integration entry to control.

days.name: Days
days.description: Requested duration; Vacation 100 means continuously on.
